acceptance.component_denominator: numerically accepted; finite positive amplitude and detected contribution; finite bounded lifetime; two positive distinct generating components; no warning-based exclusion
acceptance.vanishing_fitted_component: numerical acceptance retained; that component unavailable and excluded from component-error denominator; counted in unavailable and all-attempt joint failure rates

audit.complete_requires: all eight starts successful with finite endpoints, no exhausted budget, feasible finite best candidate and finite shared-objective recheck

execution_lock_requirements: reviewed new execution runner and denominator/integrity tests
exact interpreter, dependency freeze, platform and numerical-thread environment
explicit complete task lists and entropy identities
new output directory; refuse historical checkpoint resume

primary.audit_rule: all 100 scheduled baseline audits complete and all 100 finite production/audit shared-objective pairs agree within absolute 0.01
primary.component_metrics: unchanged accepted/available-component denominator; explicit per-component n, missingness and all-attempt joint outcomes; undefined metrics fail
